title: ARKAON-GOVERNED IDENTITY, FACE RIG, EXPRESSION QA, REPAIR, AND WEB DELIVERY
specNature: REQUIREMENTS AND ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA LOCK ONLY. This document authorizes no implementation, external generation, asset purchase, upload, publication, or deployment.
purpose: Develop and apply the relevant ARKAON planning, governance, building, verification, change-analysis, evidence, recovery, and reporting capabilities across an identity-preserving 3D face production loop from approved multi-view references through Meshy-style model acquisition, NURION face augmentation, expression QA, targeted repair, and web delivery.

forbiddenActions: mutate or replace sealed V2 source, semantic contracts, evidence, receipts, manifests, or digests
rename, reinterpret, or silently rewrite canonical BODY, FACE, TALKING, motion, or P05 semantics
mutate a user or third-party source asset in place
treat an analysis, proposal, preview, or metadata-only result as execution or PASS
bypass authorization, gate, domain service, audit, manifest, hash, tamper, or provenance checks
trust client-supplied permission, policy, gate, or proof claims without server-side verification
publish private reference images, source models, derived models, screenshots, prompts, seeds, or receipts
auto-purchase, externally upload, regenerate, overwrite, or deploy without the required authorization
claim universal topology, generator, auto-rig, facial-rig, or production compatibility

capabilityOwners.ARKAON_PLANNER: Build the bounded production plan, iteration budget, cost/risk estimate, dependencies, and measurable completion conditions.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_ARCHITECT: Define versioned contracts between reference generation, Meshy-style acquisition, NURION processing, QA, repair, and web runtime.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_GOVERNOR: Enforce authority, scope, privacy, licensing, V2 locks, state transitions, and fail-closed gates.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_BUILDER: After separate authority is granted, implement only the approved adapters, rig augmentation, repair, optimization, and packaging scope.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_VERIFIER: Run structural, behavioral, visual, preservation, provenance, reload, and web-performance verification.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_CHANGE_ANALYZER: Classify every delta as improvement, no-change, regression, identity drift, contract violation, or V2-boundary violation.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_AI_SUPERVISOR: Observe pipeline state, diagnose failures, propose the next bounded action, and never self-authorize execution.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_EVIDENCE_ENGINE: Preserve hashes, manifests, parameters, decisions, reports, and approval references without publishing private payloads.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_RECOVERY_ENGINE: Stop safely, retain the last accepted checkpoint, prevent clobber, and support deterministic rollback.
capabilityOwners.ARKAON_REPORT_ENGINE: Report status, blockers, evidence, residual risk, required human decisions, and the exact proposed next action.

requiredModules.IDENTITY-01: Approved multi-view A-pose and close-up reference set plus identity lock.
requiredModules.MESHY-01: External model acquisition and input qualification; external facial rig is never presumed production-ready.
requiredModules.FACE-01: NURION facial capability inspection and authorized append-only augmentation or isolated derived repair.
requiredModules.QA-01: Automated and human-verifiable facial expression, talking, preservation, and web QA.
requiredModules.REPAIR-01: Failure-directed internal correction, re-rig, partial reference regeneration, remesh/retopology request, or texture-only request.
requiredModules.WEB-01: Web-profile optimization, runtime state mapping, packaging, and staged delivery.

workflow.input: Human-approved character brief and rights/privacy classification
workflow.rule: All views must represent the same identity. A human approval receipt is required before any external 3D generation or upload.

workflow.input: Approved identity package and explicitly authorized external-upload bundle
workflow.rule: Use external generation for geometry, texture, and available base rig only. Do not claim production facial-rig completion from provider labels alone.
Consume sealed V2 interfaces read-only. Any new capability is isolated Post-V2 work and must not become an alternate canonical runtime authority.

workflow.input: Derived face candidate and locked identity profile
workflow.rule: A verdict must cite machine evidence and, for final acceptance, a private human visual receipt.

requiredOutputs: new candidate and delta evidence when executed
workflow.rule: Prefer the smallest failed-region correction. Whole-face regeneration is prohibited unless evidence shows partial repair cannot satisfy identity and topology criteria and a human explicitly authorizes it.

requiredOutputs: public-safe manifest and private evidence references
workflow.rule: Stage first; verify reload, runtime behavior, performance, privacy, and no-clobber before any separate deployment authorization.

identityLockContract.identityDriftRule: Compare every candidate with the last human-approved identity checkpoint using a calibrated private method. Uncalibrated universal numeric thresholds are forbidden.
identityLockContract.onDrift: REGENERATE or REJECT; never silently accept or overwrite the last PASS checkpoint.

failureRouting.shape-key vertex deformation: NURION re-rig or bounded weight/morph repair under separate authority
failureRouting.missing facial edge loops: external remesh or partial retopology proposal
failureRouting.incorrect facial geometry: targeted reference generation plus explicitly authorized external regeneration
failureRouting.neck or upper-body seam: NURION neck-fit or bounded mesh repair

iterationAndRecovery.checkpointRule: Each accepted stage produces an immutable logical checkpoint identified by manifest and artifact digests.
iterationAndRecovery.regressionRule: If a new candidate regresses any locked acceptance dimension, restore the prior accepted checkpoint and report the regression.

acceptanceCriteria.AC-01-GOVERNANCE: Every executed action has an intent, scope, authority reference, result, verification, and report following the operating protocol in order.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-02-V2-IMMUTABILITY: Independent digest comparison proves all sealed V2 authority files and the declared canonical preservation envelope were not changed.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-03-IDENTITY: The candidate matches the human-approved multi-view identity checkpoint under the locked calibration method and receives a human visual PASS.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-04-INPUT-QUALIFICATION: Rig, skin, topology, materials, textures, animation inventory, rights, privacy, provenance, and source digest are complete; ambiguity blocks processing.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-05-FACE-RUNTIME: Blink_L, Blink_R, Jaw_Mouth, VISEME_AA, VISEME_OH, and VISEME_EE produce actual visible deformation and the talking clip exists.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-06-EXPRESSION: Every expression/state in the approved expression manifest is visually distinct, structurally valid, and accepted by the private human visual review.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-07-EYES-AND-MOUTH: Blink, gaze, jaw, lips, and any approved tongue behavior show no unresolved penetration, inversion, collapse, or unintended coupling under the calibrated QA method.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-08-NEUTRAL-RETURN: Every tested expression and talking sequence returns to its recorded neutral state with zero semantic state residue; numeric geometry tolerances must come from the approved calibration lock.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-09-BODY-SKIN-PRESERVATION: sourceUnmutated is true and bodySkinDigestMatch is true for the declared source/body/skin envelope.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-10-CHANGE-ANALYSIS: Every repair candidate has a before/after diff and is classified; no unresolved regression, identity drift, or locked-contract intrusion remains.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-11-GLB-RELOAD: The staged GLB reloads successfully and its meshes, skins, morph targets, animations, materials, manifests, and digests match the staged receipt.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-12-WEB-RUNTIME: The approved ARKAON web states deterministically map to declared expressions and restore correctly after transitions; target device/browser and performance budgets must be separately calibrated and locked before implementation PASS.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-13-PRIVACY-LICENSE: No private or third-party binary or identifying source payload is committed publicly; rights and allowed-use classification are verified before each external upload and publication.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-14-EVIDENCE: All required artifacts, hashes, tool/model versions, parameters, approvals, QA results, and rollback references form a complete provenance chain.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-15-FAIL-CLOSED: Missing evidence, uncertain mapping, unauthorized action, digest mismatch, provider failure, or validation failure yields BLOCKED/REJECT and cannot render as success.
acceptanceCriteria.AC-16-HUMAN-FINAL: Final product PASS, release, publication, or deployment is declared only after an independent rerun, digest/tamper verification, and explicit human final audit.

publicAllowed: public-safe manifests containing digests and pseudonymous identifiers
publicPrivateBoundary.publicBinaryRedistribution: DENY unless a separate rights review explicitly grants it

implementationStages.AFW-P01: NOT_STARTED — private identity and QA calibration lock
implementationStages.AFW-P07: NOT_STARTED — independent rerun and audit package

transitionRule: This requirements lock grants no implementation authority. P01 private calibration and rights/privacy controls must be evidenced first. OPEN_PROTOTYPE and GRANTED require later explicit human authorization in order. Agents may reach READY_FOR_HUMAN_AUDIT but may not self-declare HUMAN_FINAL_PASS.
deferredSeparateDecisions: additional visemes, tongue/teeth, muscle simulation, and full auto-retopology
digestRule: The locked SPEC digest is SHA-256 of this file's raw UTF-8/LF bytes; do not hash a reserialization, CRLF conversion, or Git object header.
next: Complete AFW-P01 private calibration and rights/privacy lock. Do not implement, purchase, externally upload, regenerate, publish, or deploy until a later explicit OPEN_PROTOTYPE then GRANTED authorization.
